tasks.note: tests/e2e/fake-x.js: self-signed cert generated on first run (tests/e2e/certs/, gitignored). Serves HTML page at / that issues POST to /i/api/graphql/FakeReplayHash/HomeTimeline. GraphQL endpoint returns fixture.json from timeline-basic pack. CORS enabled. Port 4443 default, configurable via --port. Chrome needs --host-resolver-rules='MAP x.com 127.0.0.1' --ignore-certificate-errors.

tasks.note: tests/e2e/native-host-bootstrap.js: --setup installs Chrome native host manifest with test extension ID (mhljdmpppgbddpoijmhjnaaondpidjfn), creates E2E-specific wrapper script, ensures ~/.xtap/secret token, starts daemon if needed, then verifies: manifest correctness, native messaging protocol (simulates GET_TOKEN via stdin/stdout binary framing), and daemon HTTP /status. --teardown restores original manifest from backup, stops daemon if bootstrap started it, removes wrapper. Backs up existing user manifest to avoid clobbering. macOS + Linux paths supported.
